name: Magic axes

variantInfo.name: Magic axe
notes: Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills; the Magic Axe Hut holds 9 spawns.
The hut door requires 23 Thieving and a lockpick to open.
Attacks with slash melee at a 4-tick speed; slash (+5) and magic (+5) are its lowest defences.
The Taverley Dungeon and Catacombs of Kourend spawns do NOT count for Krystilia.

locationComparison.name: Magic Axe Hut (Wilderness)
notes: 9 Magic axe spawns inside the Wilderness Axe Hut; the door needs 23 Thieving and a lockpick.
Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.
The non-Wilderness Taverley Dungeon and Catacombs of Kourend spawns do not count for Krystilia.

taskNotes: Magic axes are a Krystilia (Wilderness) Slayer assignment: 75-125 per task, weight 7, no Slayer requirement.

Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills. Only the Magic Axe Hut spawns (npc 2844) count; the Taverley Dungeon and Catacombs of Kourend spawns do not.
Magic axes are combat level 42 with 44 Hitpoints and grant 44 Slayer XP; defence level 29 with slash (+5) and magic (+5) their lowest defences.
Reaching the axes requires opening the hut door with 23 Thieving and a lockpick.
No task extension unlock exists for Magic axes.
recommendedMethod: Open the Wilderness Axe Hut door (23 Thieving + lockpick) and kill the 9 magic axes with a slash weapon against their low slash defence (+5). Bring only cheap gear for the Wilderness.
